name: transcripts
meaning: one row per message, IN ORDER, with the message text itself

name: sessions
meaning: one row per tutoring session (34 per arm)

name: tutor_responses
meaning: one row per tutor response from the engine trace: tokens, tools, verdict

name: grades_long
meaning: one row per graded session x dimension; LONG format

name: cost_summary
meaning: metered spend per cloud arm, derived from tutor_responses

name: tutor response
meaning: ONE message from the tutor. Not an exchange: a session with 7 tutor responses also holds 6-7 student messages.

name: exchange_number
meaning: the transcript's own turn_number: a tutor message and the student reply share one value.

name: at_desideratum
meaning: TRUE if the verdict matches the dimension's target. NULL for n/a, which the taxonomy treats as unscorable, NOT as a failure.

name: session_passes
meaning: TRUE only if EVERY applicable dimension is at its desideratum (all-or-nothing). NULL if the grading is incomplete.

name: grading_complete
meaning: FALSE if fewer than 8 dimensions were answered. Exclude these: an unanswered dimension is not a 'no'.

name: peeked
meaning: the judge's grade was revealed before grading finished; such a session measures anchoring, not independent judgement.

name: assertions_passed
meaning: deterministic checks only (session ran, tools fired, grading resolved). NOT a measure of teaching quality.

name: tokens_input_*
meaning: the three input buckets are DISJOINT: a provider's input_tokens excludes cached tokens, so prompt size is their sum.

name: tokens_output_estimated
meaning: not recorded by the tracer; estimated from reply length at ~4 chars/token plus ~25 tokens for the tool call.

name: SCOPE
meaning: Geography only, 5 arms x 34 scenarios. Grades cover geography boards.
